summary.text: Richard H. Stuart is a Republican member of the Virginia Senate, representing District 25, which covers all of Caroline County, Essex County, King George County, King William County, Lancaster County, Middlesex County, Northumberland County, Richmond County and Westmoreland County, and parts of King and Queen County and Spotsylvania County, and has served in the Senate since 2008.
Stuart sits on the Senate committees on Agriculture, Conservation and Natural Resources; Commerce and Labor; Courts of Justice; and Finance and Appropriations.

paragraphs.text: Richard H. Stuart was born in Fredericksburg, Virginia on January 6, 1964, according to the Senate profile.
The profile lists Stuart's education as Virginia Wesleyan College (B.A.) and T.C. Williams School of Law (J.D.).

Memberships and affiliations listed on the profile include Woodland Academy, Past Chairman of the Board; Virginia State Bar 6th District Disciplinary Committee, Past Chairman; Trustee, Westmoreland County Volunteer Fire Department; Northern Neck Bar Association; Virginia Trial Lawyers Association; Northern Neck Land Conservancy.
